rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>An old military connection got the <book(84)>Tresor Research Institute<endbook()> to help us. Repairs on the <color(4)>Gekko<ce()><thumbnail(176)> start shortly.
rows.notes: Tresor Research Institute per glossary.json (loc.tresor). Gekko per glossary.json Gekkostate entry ('Gekko is its ship'). Compressed to fit the 128-char limit.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>But it looks like the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> already caught wind of it. They're headed this way.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Normally there's no way they'd move this fast. It's probably that bastard <color(5)>Berkt<ce()><thumbnail(189)>'s doing.
rows.notes: Holland's rough register kept ('yarou', 'ah-none'); Berkt male per glossary.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>He probably figured we'd come back and got ready for it. Exactly the kind of thing that sly bastard would do.
rows.notes: 'Exactly' used in place of 'Just' to avoid the j.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>It's a good chance to hit them, but the <color(4)>Gekko<ce()> can't move. Still, no time for griping.
<thumbdown()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>I need you to intercept them in the area and keep the enemy away from the <color(4)>Institute<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'Institute' short for the Tresor Research Institute, matching the color(4) tag on kenkyuujo.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>We've gotten too conspicuous ourselves. The <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>'s pursuit will likely grow fiercer from here.

<topic()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>The <color(5)>Frost brothers<ce()>' <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> main force<thumbnail(236)>, Intelligence's <color(5)>Dewey Novak<ce()> and his unit, <color(5)>Kids Munt<ce()>'s <book(56)>Siberian Railway<endbook()>...
rows.notes: Kids Munt: per English Wikipedia (Overman King Gainer), President of the Siberian Railway (orchestrator ruling; corrects the katakana Kizzu Munto reading, which is 'Kids' not 'Kizz'). Dewey Novak and Frost brothers already locked.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>They're tough opponents. Whatever happens, don't let your guard down.

uncertainties.issue: 'Institute' as a short stand-in for the Tresor Research Institute; no locked short form found.

'Intelligence's Dewey Novak and his unit' for jouhoubu Dewey Novak no butai: source syntax is 'the unit of Intelligence[-department]'s Dewey Novak'; rendered so the color(5) span still wraps only 'Dewey Novak' as in source.
